expectations.text: Guides auditing existing 40+ components for patterns and inconsistencies
expectations.evidence: Runs component inventory workflow: categorize by atomic level, identify duplicates, flag inconsistent implementations of similar patterns

expectations.text: Extracts design tokens from existing codebase
expectations.evidence: Provides extraction methodology: scan for hardcoded hex values, px values, font declarations; deduplicate into canonical token set with usage counts

expectations.text: Establishes atomic design structure (atoms, molecules, organisms)
expectations.evidence: Maps existing components to atomic hierarchy, identifies missing atoms (e.g., no base Button atom, 6 molecule-level button variants)

expectations.text: Defines token naming conventions for the team
expectations.evidence: Establishes naming schema: color-{semantic}-{variant}, spacing-{size}, font-{role}-{property} with examples from extracted tokens

expectations.text: Creates a refactoring plan to replace hardcoded values with tokens
expectations.evidence: Phased refactoring plan: Phase 1 tokens file + CSS variables, Phase 2 high-usage components, Phase 3 remaining components, with file-by-file priority

expectations.text: Produces a design system setup deliverable
expectations.evidence: Outputs design-system-setup.md with token definitions, component inventory, naming conventions, and phased migration plan
